race.comment: THERE GOES MY HERO (3) ran on strongly late for fourth here 3 weeks ago when resuming from a spell, and he has a slightly better draw this time. He usually improves quickly second up, and is overdue for another win. CHUR NIBBLE (2) had a lot of issues when beaten as the favourite at Strathalbyn 8 weeks ago, and has since relocated to a new stable. He has had some gear changes in an effort to get him to settle better, and with the aid of a 1.5kg claim, he can bounce straight back into the money. TALENT SCOUT (1) needed the run fresh up at Morphettville before bolting home as the favourite here 3 weeks ago. This is no tougher, and even with the weight rise, he can win again. ONLY ONE RULER (9) won on debut by a head here 3 weeks ago, and the only surprise was the big price that he paid. He skips a couple of grades, and with less weight to carry, he can take the net step immediately. CHESTERAY (6) won fresh up by a nose, and with a rise in class, he drops 3.5kg. Stick with him.
